name: issues
description: Nine real bugs click shipped and fixed, reverted source-only so each has its original regression test. Graded by the test suite.
files:
`echo_via_pager` with a generator shows nothing until the generator is exhausted. Each chunk should reach the pager as it is produced, so long output starts appearing immediately.

Failing:
  tests/test_termui.py::test_echo_via_pager_streams_each_write

`click.echo` misbehaves when given empty bytes and a custom file.

Failing:
  tests/test_utils/test_echo.py::test_echo_custom_file

The shell completion source scripts come out with platform line endings. They have to use LF everywhere, or the shells reject them.

Failing:
  tests/test_shell_completion.py::test_source_uses_lf_line_endings

An optional `Choice` or `DateTime` argument is shown with doubled brackets in the usage synopsis.

Failing:
  tests/test_basic.py::test_choice_argument_optional_metavar
  tests/test_basic.py::test_datetime_argument_optional_metavar

When a group can be invoked without a subcommand, its usage line still presents the subcommand as required. It should be marked optional.

Failing:
  tests/test_commands.py::test_subcommand_metavar_marks_optional

The progress bar does not land on its final position when it finishes -- the last render stops short.

Failing:
  tests/test_termui.py::test_progressbar_lands_on_final_position

`get_help_option_names` does not preserve the order the help option names were declared in.

Failing:
  tests/test_commands.py::test_get_help_option_names

A deprecated command with empty help renders its deprecation label with a stray leading space.

Failing:
  tests/test_commands.py::test_deprecated_empty_help_no_leading_space
  tests/test_options.py::test_deprecated_empty_help_no_leading_space

`HelpFormatter.write_usage` produces spurious characters when there are no arguments.

Failing:
  tests/test_formatting.py::test_command_write_usage_no_args
  tests/test_formatting.py::test_help_formatter_write_usage_without_args_styled_prefix
  tests/test_formatting.py::test_help_formatter_write_usage
briefing:
This is a checkout of click, the command-line library. Nine issues have been reported against it and I am going to hand them to you one at a time. Each comes with the tests that fail because of it.

Run tests with `.venv/bin/python -m pytest`. The suite takes a few seconds.

For every issue: find the cause in src/click and fix it there. Never modify, skip or delete a test to make it pass. Do not break anything that currently works.

Acknowledge and wait for the first issue.

checks.description: issue 1 fixed: Support incremental output in the pager
issue 2 fixed: handle empty bytes in echo
issue 3 fixed: Implement Unix line endings for shell completion output to ensure comp
issue 4 fixed: Fix double-bracketing of choices in synopsis
issue 5 fixed: Mark commands as optional in the synopsis
issue 6 fixed: Land the progress bar on its final position
issue 7 fixed: Preserve declaration order of help option names
issue 8 fixed: Fix deprecated label formatting
issue 9 fixed: Fix `HelpFormatter.write_usage` producing spurious characters
the whole suite passes -- nothing else was broken on the way
no test was modified, skipped or deleted to make it pass
